scripts.speaker: Noyee
scripts.text: Did you know that there's a difference between the armor you can buy from NPC shops and the kinds you obtain from hunting monsters?

scripts.speaker: Noyee
scripts.text: The difference, my friend, is in the number of ^3355FFslots^000000 in your armor.

scripts.speaker: Noyee
scripts.text: The same kind of Armor will have the same Defense. However, if an Armor has a slot, you can insert a Monster Card which will add an enhancement to that armor.

scripts.speaker: Noyee
scripts.text: Both Monster Cards and Slotted Armors are rarely dropped by monsters, and are thus valuable commodies.

scripts.text:
You know, there's a very interesting place that looks
sort of like a laboratory in Juno.

scripts.speaker: Noyee
scripts.text: Anyway, no one is really sure if it is or not. Recently, it's been the focus of many rumors. I have no idea if any of them are true though.
^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: I can't believe how busy I am at work nowadays. I don't even have time to see any of my friends or go shopping.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Wait...!
I can't even remember the last
time I went out with a guy! At this rate, I might retire before I can find a boyfriend. Noooo, I'm still in my prime~!

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: We conduct research on godly artifacts that were left behind by the gods long ago. More specifically, we're interested in the tools the gods used.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Recently, many of the members of our research group, aside from the leaders, have left so now we're short on manpower.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Since we're understaffed, we can't continue most of our research projects that are currently in progress. Speaking of which...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Do you mind if I ask
an adventurer like yourself
to help us in our research?

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: We won't experiment on you or anything, we just need you to run some simple errands. And of course, you will be rewarded.
I'm kind of busy...
Sure, why not?

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Oh, I see.
Well, if you happen to find anyone that might work well as a temporary research assistant, would you recommend them to us?

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
I'm so sorry to ask this of you, but I hope you understand that we're seriously lacking in terms
of human resources.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Really~?!
That's great!
Hahahahaha! I'm so
glad to hear that!

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Go inside and speak to the investigators there. They're all kind of swamped, so I'm sure they'll need your assistance.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Oh, wait...
Let me give you a temporary admission pass. Thank you
so much for your help~

^3355FFYou've received
a temporary
admission pass.^000000

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: It's really difficult to managing a laboratory. Rival labs always try to entice our staff away or interrupt our progress.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
And because of this job, it's really hard for me to enjoy
having a personal life...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Hahahaha...
What am I doing?
Please just ignore what I just said. It's really not that big of a deal. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Ah, thank you
for helping us out.
I hope you'll continue
to lend us your assistance.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Although our researchers are kind of strange, they're all pretty nice and they mean well.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: So I hope you understand if a few of them treat you in a way that seems kind of rude.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Ah...
You really helped us out a lot. Thank you for all you have done.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: As you already know, we're trying to find out whether or not we can reproduce 'Sleipnir,' one of the tools used by the gods.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
However....
So far it seems impossible, at least with the technology that we currently have. Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Anyways, we will continue to research and hope that we'll be able to accomplish our goal of recreating Sleipnir someday.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Thanks to you, we were able to complete a rudimentary study of Sleipnir. Now we can plan out a more advanced study of Sleipnir.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Before I forget, let me give you your reward for assisting in our research projects. Please give
me a minute...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Ah, there it is.
It might not be much, but I hope you accept it as a token of my gratitude. Good luck on your travels!

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Ah, I'll also need to take back that temporary pass I gave to you. I'm sorry, but it's protocol we have to follow...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Once again,
thank you for
all your help~

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: With your assistance, we successfully completed our rudimentary study.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: From now on, we'll plan out our more advanced studies based on the information we now have on the godly artifacts.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Now that things
have slowed down
a little...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
I can finally
go on a date!
Hahahahahaha~!

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text:
Ah, you've come back.
I know you were going to help us, but someone already applied for the assistant position.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Anyway, we've already finished our current research projects. Now, we're in the planning stages for the next projects we'll be conducting...

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Thank you anyway, though. I hope you will come and help us the next time we need assistance on our projects.

scripts.speaker: Cukure
scripts.text: Now that we've completed our rudimentary studies, we'll simply plan out our future research projects.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Ah, are you the one whom Ms. Kirin referred? Yes, she said you were going to help me in my research.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Frankly, we don't really need anyone who doesn't specialize
in our field of study.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: But if you don't mind helping us out by doing little, menial tasks, then it'd probably bring some relief to our workload.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Now...
What would be
a good job for you?
Let me think...

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
I got it!
Why don't you go and visit ^FF0000Metto^000000 for me? Please bring me any news that he'd like to report.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Since he's working on a project similar to mine, he might be in a position to help me. Metto lives in Juno, so you can easily find me.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: I guess you haven't found Metto yet. Although he might be a little over enthusiastic at times, he's not a bad guy at all.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: We've been friends for a long time after working in the same field for so long. I wonder how he's doing?

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Anyway, just ask him about any progress on his research. And if he happens to ask you for help, please lend him your assistance.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
So how's Metto?
Hmm? It seems like
he has changed...

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
So how's Metto?

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
A mad scientist?
That doesn't sound right. In my wildest dreams, I never would have suspected Metto of turning out that way...

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Huh. That's...
That's too bad. I don't know what to say. We used to go watch movies and celebrate our birthdays together. P-please give me a moment...

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Ah...
You came back.
Alright, let me give you the gist of what I'm researching.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: I'm trying to learn more about the '^FF0000Wheel of the Unknown^000000,' which was discovered to be a piece of the artifact known as ^FF0000Sleipnir^000000.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
It looks like
a normal cogwheel...
But I can't figure out how it's supposed to work.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
The most peculiar thing of all about this cogwheel is the metal
of which it is composed.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: It looks and feels like steel,but extreme heat and cold don't affect it. It also cannot be dented by any kind of impact or force I can apply to it.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Sometimes, I find that the Wheel of the Unknown resonates with certain objects, but I haven't got it to occur all of the time.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: I'm guessing that I'm missing some sort of special condition that will make the Wheel of the Unknown resonate with specific materials.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Anyway, I thank you for helping me out earlier. That's basically all I needed, so please talk to the other researchers and see if they need any assistance.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Oh, sorry.
I'm quite busy compiling all of this information at the moment.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Let's see...
Now how would I...
^333333*Mumble mumble*^000000

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
How does this work?
There's still too much we don't know about the godly artifacts. ^333333*Sigh*^000000

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: It's not easy, working on this alone. Having an extra pair of hands is always good.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Right now, I just need someone with whom I can share the workload. Still, different assistants might be better depending on the project.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Basically, if an assistant is especially trained in the field related to my current research project, he'll probably be more useful than someone who's not.

scripts.speaker: Hallandaute
scripts.text: Of course, there are people who are good at everything. But since those are rare, I try to choose just the right assistant for each of my projects.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Nice to meet you.
You're the temporary assistant, right? That's great, all of us are having a hard time working
without much help.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Okay...
Let me explain
to you the project
that I'm working on.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
I'm trying to find out everything I can about the '^FF0000Feather of Angel Wing^000000.' Supposedly, it's one of
the parts of 'Sleipnir.'

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Right now, I'm
focusing on studying
the background story of this feather, as well as how it came
to be a material for a godly artifact.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: I was recently told that there is a person in Payon who actually knows this story. Very few people in the world are privy to having such knowledge.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Now, we don't have enough
staff for me to send someone to Payon. Also, I don't feel safe taking this feather around with me.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
It shouldn't be that difficult to find the person who knows about Sleipnir's origin. However, you must memorize every single
word of the story.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: The results of this research could be affected by the words you deliver to me.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Thank you for the trouble.
There's no real time limit for this task, but the sooner you complete it, the better.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Have a safe trip~

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Mmm...?
You haven't left for Payon yet to find the man who knows of Sleipnir's origin?

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Please leave for
Payon as soon as
possible so that I can get the information that I need for my research. Thank you, and have
a safe trip.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Ah, you're back. So have you memorized the story?

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: I know it'd be much easier if this tale was already written, but you must understand that many stories regarding the gods are only orally transmitted.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Alright,
I'm listening.
Please let me
know what you've learned.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Hmm, I see.
Fascinating.
However, I'm sure
you've missed some
important detail.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Are you sure you've listened to the tale in its entirety? I'm sorry to ask this of you, but would you go to Payon and listen to this story once more?

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Mm...?
You haven't left
for Payon yet...?
I hope you can
tell me the rest
of the story soon.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
In the meantime, I will try to complete as much of my research
as I can with the story details that you've already brought.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:

So have you
memorized the story?

you've missed some

Well, um...
Impossible!

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Hmm.
No, wait...
That was the
complete story.
My apologies~

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text:
Ah~
I stand corrected.
Thank you for pointing
out my error in judgment.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Yes, it seems that the story you've just told me should be authentic. Of course, it's understandable if little changes are made, depending on the storyteller.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Surely, I'll be able to answer some of my most important questions with the information you've brought to me, though it still won't be easy.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: After all, finding answers tends to cause new questions to arise. Nonetheless, I thank you for your help.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Sometimes, different versions of the same myth or legend arise.

scripts.speaker: Aadin
scripts.text: Although myths, as they change with time, may conflict with each other, the fundamental basis of these stories is what makes them timeless.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Ah, you must be
the new assistant.
Pleased to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: In all honesty, I was expecting someone with a bit more experience in the field of research, but it's understandable.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: After all, we're not in the position to expect professional assistance. In any case, I believe you'll bring a new perspective to our work.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: I've almost completed my project and don't need too much in the way of manpower. However, the last task I need finished is difficult.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: I was thinking of using my own funds to hire an outside agency, but there's no need to do that now that you're here~

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: What I'd like to ask you to do is to gather materials so that I can create the 'Spirit of Fish.'

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: I'm not sure if I can actually produce it or not, but we can at least give this experiment a try.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: Basically, you and collect things like 'Fish Scales' or Fish Tails,' basically anything you can obtain from marine life.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
I don't need a
ridiculous amount of one
kind of material, I'd say about 10 of one kind of each item should work. Give or take 5...

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: I should mention that I also require a good variety of marine related materials. You can't conduct an experiment without different objects to test, right?

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: Anyway, I hope you don't run into too much trouble finding what I need for this experiment. Good luck~

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Ah, you've returned.
Okay, let me check
what you brought to me. Hmm...

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Ooh...
I could use these.
And these too. Oh!
You adventurers carry
a lot of things, don't you?

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Ah....!
The materials you have should be enough for me to conduct my experiment. Thank you so much.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: With these, I can continue my research without any problem. I'm pleasantly surprised with the job you've done.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
You really were
such a great help.
Thank you so much!
Hahaha....!

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Now, there may be
other researchers
who might need your help in completing their projects. Why don't you ask around to see if
they need anything?

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Still, you don't seem to have enough materials for me to
complete my research
Remember, I need
a huge variety.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
I'm sorry for the hassle, but do you think you could go out and collect things so that I can attempt to recreate the
'Spirit of Fish?'

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text:
Hmmm....
Funds and
manpower are
important for
research to progress.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: But no amount of financing or staffing can replace the value of enthusiasm and passion in conducting research.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: Some financiers are so ignorant that they think that if they throw more money and people into a project, the secrets of science will be unlocked that much faster.

scripts.speaker: Kurdt
scripts.text: But if the people doing your research are unmotivated and uninspired, you'll never get anywhere.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: No matter how old the stories are, you can always find good advice in folk tales and legends.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Despite the passing of time and mankind's progression, certain fundamentals of life are timeless and will never change.
Umm...
I see.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Do you need
anything from me?
I will try to help
you as much as I can.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I believe that it's no use having ability or power unless you use that power for the right purposes.
Oh no, that's okay.
Sleipnir's story.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
I must have
misunderstood me.
However, feel free
to ask me for help
if you ever need it.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I consider helping others as special training for my spiritual improvement. I hope that you will act with kindness and generosity towards others as well.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Ah, I see.
I can tell you what I know about Sleipnir. Let's see now if I can remember everything about it.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Ah yes.
I remember it now.
Yes, Sleipnir was the
name of Odin's stallion.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
In the world of
gods, there were
three legendary stallions: Sleipnir, Svadilfari and Gullfaxi.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Gullfaxi was owned by Hrungnir, the king of the giants. Svadilfari, the stallion that sired Sleipnir, was also owned by a giant.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Okay, now let's talk about how 'Sleipnir' was born. This story gives us a glimpse of the fallibility of gods and giants.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: In Asgard, the realm of the gods, there was a huge protective rampart that was almost completely destroyed in a recent war.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
However...
Gods being gods,
they were not eager
to rebuild the walls
themselves.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
One day, a very
skinny man rode on
a dark horse and offered to rebuild, and even improve, the rampart protecting Asgard.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: His offer was tempting to the gods, who needed every protection from their enemies.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
This man promised to rebuild
the Asgardian rampart in only 18 months, but in return he wanted the goddess Freya as his wife, as well as ownership of the sun and the moon.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Now, this price was unreasonable for the gods to pay. The Asgardians were all insulted and angered by the stranger's demands. Still, they did want their rampart to be rebuilt.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, we can
finish this
story later.
Yeah, let's finish this later.
No, please go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I understand that my story was not that interesting. But I will try my best to entertain you next time. Please travel in safety.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Oh alright.
Then let me continue.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
The gods were furious with the stranger's ridiculous demands. However, Loki proposed to Odin
that they should let the stranger rebuild their defensive walls.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Loki suggested that if the stranger could complete most of the rampart renovation, but later than as agreed, the gods would not be obligated to pay the stranger any price.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Odin decided to follow Loki's advice, and told the stranger that the wall must be repaired in 6 months, instead of 18 months as the stranger had proposed. He could receive help from no man.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: In return, the stranger would be paid as he had asked if he could fulfill those conditions. Since he was just a man, it seemed impossible.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
I know this story is quite long. Did you want to listen some more, or did you need a break?
Let me take down some notes first.
I need a break!
No, please go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Ah....
I understand this story is quite long. My apologies. Alright, I'll wait for you to finish writing your notes.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: May I continue the story now?
Yes, please.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Okay, now
where was I?

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I understand that the tale of Sleipnir is pretty long. But if you have the patience, I will try to relate this story to you another time. Farewell~

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Oh good.
Then please let me continue.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Now, the stranger insisted that he be able to use his horse to help him do this reconstruction work. Since the horse was rather plain and simple looking, Odin agreed.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Odin didn't think
twice about his
request, and regretted this decision upon observing the stranger's first day of rebuilding the rampart.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Strangely enough, the stranger, using his horse to carry the materials, rebuilt the rampart at a speed that was inhuman.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
This upset the gods, since the stranger was actually a mighty giant in disguise. However, this did not violate their agreement,
so the gods could do nothing.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Although the stranger's skills were great, his horse greatly sped up the rampart reconstruction. This was the legendary magical horse, Svadilfari.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: The gods grew more anxious as the wall would soon be completed before the alloted six months were up. The Asgardians soon grew very angry with Loki.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Despite this, Loki remained calm and assured the gods that he had a plan. The gods distrusted his craftiness, and grew desperate as the stranger's work speedily progressed.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Then, the reconstruction of the rampart suddenly halted. Both the gods and the stranger were equally surprised, as the horse Svadilfari was now missing.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
The stranger would
now need to continue
his work by himself.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Are you still listening? If you're tired, I understand and we can
stop for now.
I'm so exhausted!
No, please go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I know that this story might seem too long. But if you ever want to sit down and hear it again, I'll be glad to go over it again. Thank you for listening, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Oh alright,
I'll go on then.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: In their curiosity, the gods decided to investigate Savdilfari's disappearance.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Surprisingly,
they found that
Svadilfari fell in love with a beautiful mare, which was why
it did not work on the rampart.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: So when the 6 months passed, the stranger almost finished rebuilding the Asgardian walls. Only the castle gate was left untouched.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: The gods were happy to tell the stranger that they could not pay him what he requested, since he did not complete the rampart as originally agreed.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: In his rage, the stranger accused the gods of tricking him so that they would not have to pay him with the sun, the moon and the beautiful goddess Freya. Then, he revealed his true identity.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
He was a
terrible frost giant,
or Hrimthurs as they say.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, we can
talk about this
later you know.
I'm so bored~
No, please go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I see. Well, stories are meant to be enjoyed and I suppose you're not in the mood to sit and listen.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: But if you ever do want to hear about Sleipnir, feel free to visit me once again. Have a good day~

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Oh, I'm glad~
Some people would
actually be sleeping
after listening so long~

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Anyway...
The stranger turned out
to be a giant training in
stone masonry. Although he was invading Asgard, the gods didn't worry.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Thor quickly killed the giant with his mighty hammer, Mjolnir, by hurling it at the giant's head, which exploded into a thousand pieces.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
As for the horse, Svadilfari, it was nowhere to be found for
a long, long time.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
.....
Are you bored?
If you are, let's talk
about this later.
Let me take down some notes.
See you later.
No, please go ahead.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Ah....
I see that you really want to keep track of every important detail!

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: My apologies, I'll wait for you to complete your notes then.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: May I continue the story now?
Yes, please.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Okay. Hmm...
Now where was I?

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Oh, I guess my story wasn't really that interesting. But if you want to listen to this story again, please come visit me again.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Okay then,
travel safely~

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Okay. Hmm...
Now where was I?

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: After a while, Loki, who looked tattered and worn out, brought a strange looking pony with eight legs to Asgard.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
Loki introduced the pony as 'Sleipnir' and presented it to
Odin as a present.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: In actuality, Loki transformed into the mare that seduced Svadilfari so that it would no longer work on the rampart.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: So 'Sleipnir' was born from the legendary mare Svadilfari, and the god Loki who transformed himself into a horse.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Now, stories that are spread through word of mouth might have differences in the small details, depending on who's telling the story.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Still, the fundamental story line should not be different.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I don't usually get to practice storytelling, and I'm not too confident of the authenticity of my version of Sleipnir's tale.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: But I hope you will understand that I did my best. It was the most that I could do to help you.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text:
If you wish to listen to this story again, you're always welcome.
Be safe on your adventures~

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: In times of agony, please reflect on your past to help you find a solution.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Like the old myths and legends, your experiences are stories from which you can learn valuable lessons.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: I told you everything I know. Hopefully, I was of some help to you. Please treat others with the same generosity and kindness.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Training isn't limited to just physical and mental conditioning.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: The way you lead your life and interact with other people can also be considered part of your training.

scripts.speaker: Lania
scripts.text: Everyone will learn and benefit differently, depending on how they live their day to day lives.

scripts.speaker: Lania
